items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: What did you say he used to play over here with Joe Harris? Joe Harris. Joe Harris. He used good sax too, man.

ctx.x: Did he play around here much? With Sam Morgan. He come over with him. I see all of the coast, Buffaloes, Moabill, Sam Morgan and the rural all of that. Oh yeah.
What did you say he used to play over here with Joe Harris? Joe Harris. Joe Harris. He used good sax too, man. He used good sax. He was playing recently but I haven't seen him here.
He used to play with the Amethystogonians, man. He had a stroke.
